{{Quote|Captain, Durren reports that their hyperspace orbiter has picked up a Cronau radiation event in our sector. Confidence is high that a large ship has reverted to realspace.|A comm officer to [[Skent Graff]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>}}
'''Cronau radiation''' was [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] emitted by an object entering or leaving [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] along an axis perpendicular to the object's [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] vector. For a vessel with zero space velocity, the Cronau radiation would collapse into a narrow wave cone, which could be directed away from enemy sensors. This technique was used by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[stasis probe]]s during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. Properly configured sensors could detect Cronau radiation from a ship emerging from hyperspace at greater range than would otherwise be possible, as in the case of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron's]] arrival at [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
